correctness.rationale: On each atom x the norm of evaluation equals w_x=Φ⁻¹(1/p_x), since the one-coordinate modular bound is attained by w_x times the singleton indicator. Integrable w gives a common full-probability event via the scalar strong laws on all coordinates and on a countable finite-set exhaustion of the tails; it gives convergence even in empirical-functional norm. If E w=∞, independence and the tail-sum test imply w(X_n)/n is unbounded almost surely. Equivalently to the proof's uniform boundedness step, select increasing n_j with w(X_n_j)/n_j≥j2^j and sum the positive norm-one singleton witnesses with coefficients 2⁻ʲ. The series converges in the Luxemburg space (and evaluations converge), and its empirical means exceed j at n_j. Integrability follows from Φ≥identity. The logarithmic inverse asymptotic follows by bounding the integral on its last half and all of [0,t]. For the automorphism formula, Hom factor sizes give ℓ^S endomorphisms; reduction on G/ℓG is block triangular by cyclic-order size and invertibility requires each multiplicity block to be invertible. The correction to log |Aut| is O(√S), uniformly by the column bound. The Gaussian estimate on the square-partition product gives log N(s)=O(s^(1/3)); the disjoint binary-column families make the opposite strict side diverge. The cyclic-type witness has a summable Orlicz modular but each q-moment q>1 diverges. The endpoint is not decided.
residual_risks: The verifier checks only small group orders and weights and is not a strong-law certificate; the infinite proof is analytic. The law assumes iid idealized samples, not arithmetic sampling. No verdict is made for β=1/3.

value.rationale: The exact atomic test converts a simultaneous convergence question into a checkable property of the mass distribution and controls the norm of the empirical functional when it holds. For the standard Cohen–Lenstra law this yields an explicit boundary within classes strictly beyond every positive extra power moment; the failure result is equally informative and does not contradict the scalar strong law.
residual_risks: No critical-endpoint conclusion, quantitative convergence rates or arithmetic-family consequences are established.
